# Intent: Asset tracker

## Problem
IT tracks employee laptops in a spreadsheet; assignments drift and audits take days.

## Users
- IT admins who assign and retire laptops.
- Employees who need to see what they hold.

## Outcomes
- Every laptop has exactly one current holder or is Available.

## Constraints
- Developer Edition org; no managed packages.

## Non-goals
- Procurement and purchase orders.

## Open questions
- Do contractors get laptops too?
